title: Tight Query-Security Tradeoff for Two-Round Even–Mansour
summary: Proven security and a generic attack bound different query regimes for two-round Even–Mansour with one inner permutation; the tight tradeoff in the intermediate regime remains open.

formal_statement.body: Determine the tight query-security tradeoff for the two-round Even--Mansour construction with a single inner permutation, as a function of the number $q_e$ of outer-cipher queries and $q_p$ of inner-permutation queries. Proven security covers one range of $(q_e,q_p)$, while a generic attack establishes insecurity in another; the security status of the intermediate parameter pairs remains unresolved.

scope.domain: Block-cipher query security for the two-round Even–Mansour construction with a single inner permutation.
scope.unresolved_remainder: Determine the security status of the intermediate query-parameter pairs and thereby establish the tight query-security tradeoff.

progress.summary: The source compares proven secure regions with a generic-attack insecurity region and explicitly marks the intervening single-permutation parameter region as open.
citation_labels: Shan Chen et al., Minimizing the Two-Round Even-Mansour Cipher
